name: codegloss
description: Shows Japanese translations of English code comments in the editor

codegloss.server.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `codegloss-lsp` binary to run instead of the one shipped with this extension. Point this at a local build while working on the server.

codegloss.server.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra arguments appended to the server's command line, after the ones built from the settings below.

codegloss.model.pack.markdownDescription: Directory holding the translation model pack (`--model-pack`). Leave unset and the server downloads one on first start.

codegloss.model.precision.markdownDescription: How the weights are held in memory (`--precision`). `f16` halves the memory the model takes.

codegloss.model.beams.markdownDescription: Beam search width (`--beams`). `1` is greedy decoding: faster, and worse.

codegloss.model.download.markdownDescription: Let the server fetch the model pack by itself when it has none. Turning this off (`--no-download`) leaves comments untranslated until a pack is installed by hand.

codegloss.cache.directory.markdownDescription: Directory finished translations are written to (`--cache-dir`), so that a restart does not translate them again.

codegloss.cache.enabled.markdownDescription: Keep finished translations on disk. Turning this off (`--no-cache`) makes every session start from nothing.

codegloss.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the language server to the CodeGloss output channel.
